fusions.name: Spook the Herd
fusions.desc: You dart squeaking among every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and knocking them back 2 tiles. Each has a 40% chance to be turned against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Big One
fusions.desc: A bite at the hock that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Hidden Among Hooves
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: One of Many
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
